data.title: Is Michael Saylor's bitcoin strategy losing its appeal?
data.description: As Strategy (MSTR) valuation reportedly dips below the value of its bitcoin (BTC-USD) holdings. "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley welcome Barron's reporter Jacob Sonenshine to discuss Michael Saylor's strategy. Raising a bigger question: Are investors buying into the bitcoin play or betting on Saylor himself?
